notice: SYNTHETIC test data only. Not Finance-approved, not real accounting, not authoritative. Proposal packet SC-13 reporting-v1.
not_covered_by_schema: Cross-document equality between a query and its manifest (scope, period, currency, modes, policy refs, snapshot).
Digest correctness: any 64-hex lowercase digest other than all zeros passes.
start_utc < end_utc, calendar validity (for example February 30), as_of_utc ordering.
Timezone and currency registry membership; environment, billing-mode and accounting-class vocabularies.
Decimal scale versus precision.max_fraction_digits, decimal sums, ratio arithmetic, zero-denominator detection.
Whether negative amounts are legal for a given metric (the schema permits a leading minus except negative zero).
Consistency of coverage counts, completeness, missing_source_ids and unknown amounts or watermarks.
Uniqueness inside arrays of objects (metric keys, source ids, provenance ids).
Cursor bound_snapshot_id and query_hash agreement with the query; cursor tamper evidence.
Object reference reachability, access and tenant ownership; redaction of ids.
Finance metric definitions, class/sign matrices and recognition rules; none are modelled here.
